subject.why: The coconut drink is instantly recognisable and includes all requested elements: half-open coconut shell, straw, cocktail umbrella, and lime slice.

category.why: The drink rests on a flat, solid-coloured surface with a smooth, gradient wall behind it, both sharing a warm orange palette with clear value separation.

clean.why: There is no UI, frame, text, watermark, or character present.

framing.why: The coconut drink is centered nicely with generous, balanced margins around all edges.

colour.why: Bright and saturated warm tones; the brown coconut, white rim, and green lime contrast clearly against the orange background.

detail.why: Clean shapes with no distracting micro-textures, ridges, or unnecessary clutter.

style.why: Chunky, smooth 3D forms with a clean satin sheen, perfectly matching the casual game reference aesthetic.
